name: save_agent
description: Save an agent definition into the user catalog (~/.config/agentrunner/agents/<name>.yaml) — the ONLY way to write there; file tools cannot leave the workspace. The YAML is fully validated before anything lands on disk: invalid specs are rejected with the parse error and nothing is written. The spec's `name:` field must equal the name argument. Once saved, the agent is immediately usable: it appears in the webui's agent picker and `agentrunner new <name>` accepts it. An existing agent is never overwritten unless overwrite is set.

name.description: Agent name, a bare identifier (lowercase letters, digits, - and _). Becomes the filename <name>.yaml and must equal the spec's `name:` field.

yaml.description: The complete agent spec YAML (name, system_prompt or system_prompt_file, tools, and any optional fields). Must not contain a `model:` field — the model is chosen per session, not per agent.

overwrite.description: Replace an existing <name>.yaml. Without this, saving over an existing agent fails so an accidental clobber cannot happen.
